title: Preface
summary: Declassified-style report on SRI experiments with Uri Geller, August 4-11, 1973, testing apparent extrasensory picture-drawing ability under controlled conditions. Sessions used a shielded room and remote targets; Geller drew firecracker (drum response), grapes (matched, 24 grapes), devil with trident (partial), solar system (similar), while clairvoyance and EEG tests on Aug 6-7 failed. Authors note no sensory leakage found and conclude Geller showed convincing ability, though the report also notes cultural and associational influences on his drawings.

title: — Sur\ _
summary: Summarizes CIA-declassified notes on Uri Geller remote-viewing experiments, August 4-11, 1973. Covers shielded-room drawing tests (camel, Golden Gate Bridge, seagull), a computer-TV graphics test (kite, square with diagonals, airplanes), computer-memory storage tests (church, arrow in suitcase), and long-distance telepathy tests with East Coast scientists (mountains, chess, brain cross-section). Notes successes, failures, and two hypotheses: clairvoyance or telepathy.
